explosive.title: Explosive Power Assessment
explosive.subtitle: Torque axis uses the jump average only; 100 m is specialty-only.
explosive.fieldsHint: Uses age and sex from Home. Torque axis = (standing vertical + standing long jump) / 2. 100 m is specialty-only and never enters six-axis.
explosive.capVerticalJump: Standing vertical jump capped at {{max}} {{unit}}. Scores use capped measurement.
explosive.capStandingLongJump: Standing long jump capped at {{max}} {{unit}}. Scores use capped measurement.
explosive.capSprint100m: 100 m time floored to {{min}} s. Specialty scores use floored time.
explosive.averageRawLabel: Power axis average (standing vertical + standing long jump) / 2
explosive.radarClampNote: Radar axis clamps to 0–200 when formula average is outside range.
explosive.nextMilestoneHint: Next Milestone: {{points}} pts until next tier upgrade.
explosive.profileIncompleteHint: Complete Home profile (sex, age, height, weight) for explosive scoring.

howToInfo.title: Test Instructions
howToInfo.verticalJump: Standing vertical jump (cm) — reach difference from standing to jump peak; six-axis power core.
howToInfo.standingLongJump: Standing long jump (cm) — six-axis power core.
howToInfo.sprint: 100 m sprint (s) — specialty optional; never enters six-axis.
howToInfo.tip: Warm up before testing. Use a standard track for 100 m.

standardsInfo.title: Norm Tables & Scoring Context
standardsInfo.disclaimer: Scores map to age/sex norms — fitness self-tracking only, not medical diagnosis.
standardsInfo.noAnchorsHint: No norm row for profile age (~12–80).
standardsInfo.profileIncompleteForAnchors: Complete Home profile (age and sex) first.
standardsInfo.sourceBody: Public fitness norms and field-test literature inform the reference anchors.
standardsInfo.basisVjump: Standing vertical jump — six-axis core; averaged with standing long jump.
standardsInfo.basisSlj: Standing long jump — six-axis core; averaged with standing vertical jump.
standardsInfo.basisSprint: 100 m — specialty only; never falls back into six-axis.
standardsInfo.remark: Displayed anchors match scoring rows in this app.

errors.missing-profile: Complete physical profile on Home first.
errors.age-out-of-range: No norm table for this age (through 80).
errors.power-no-standard: Could not resolve norm rows — verify age and sex.
errors.no-inputs: Enter at least one test value.
errors.invalid-vertical-jump: Enter a positive standing vertical jump ({{unit}}).
errors.invalid-standing-long-jump: Enter a positive standing long jump ({{unit}}).
errors.invalid-sprint: Sprint time must be empty or positive (seconds).
